class.name: SfxBank
class.brief_description: A named set of [SfxEvent]s and the parameters they read.
class.description: What [member SfxPlayer.bank] plays - roughly FMOD's bank. Declares the parameters of a player using it: raw ones the game sets ([member parameters]) and ones computed from those ([member derived_parameters]).

members.member: Parameters computed from others every tick, in this order (one may read those before it).
The events, found by their [member SfxEvent.name]. Assign a new array to change it - an array changed in place is not seen.
The parameters a player of this bank has: [method SfxPlayer.set_parameter] sets them, every event reads them.
